title: ComposeSemanticsPayload
description: Payload for the `compose/semantics` data product: the Compose semantics tree projected for a render. Kotlin source of truth: ComposeSemanticsPayload / ComposeSemanticsNode in :data-layoutinspector-core. Each node carries a stable `ref` (see #1784).

typography.description: Resolved typographic identity of the text this node draws — size, face, weight, style, axes (#1934, #1903). Omitted when the node declares nothing typographic.

textColor.description: Resolved text colours (#1903). Omitted when the node draws no coloured text.

textOverflow.description: Resolved text line/overflow metrics (#1903). Omitted when the node draws no text.

clickable.description: Defaults to false; omitted when default.

tokens.description: Resolved design-token data from this node's modifiers (#1897). Omitted when the node declares none.

ComposeSemanticsTypography.description: Resolved typographic identity of the text a node draws (#1934, #1903), read from its TextLayoutResult. Each field is present only when every drawn range agrees on it; a node that declares nothing typographic omits the object entirely.

fontSize.description: Resolved text size in sp (`22.0sp`) — the former flat `layoutFontSize` (#1903).

fontFamily.description: Resolved typeface identity: a GenericFontFamily's name, or a FontListFontFamily's resolved-face identity (font file path / declared name / `res/font/<id>`).

fontVariationSettings.description: Variable-font axes applied to the resolved face, `<axis> <value>` pairs sorted by tag (`opsz 18.0, wght 700.0`).

ComposeSemanticsTextColor.description: Resolved text colours (#1903) — the consolidation home for the former flat `layoutForegroundColor` / `layoutBackgroundColor`. ARGB hex `#AARRGGBB`.

foreground.description: Resolved text foreground colour as ARGB hex `#AARRGGBB`.

background.description: Resolved text background colour as ARGB hex `#AARRGGBB`; usually unset.

ComposeSemanticsTextOverflow.description: Resolved text line/overflow metrics (#1903) — the consolidation home for the former flat `layoutLineCount` / `layoutMaxLines` / `layoutOverflow` / `layoutTruncated` / `layoutDidOverflow{Width,Height}`.

truncated.description: Whether any text had visual overflow.

didOverflowWidth.description: Whether the text overflowed its width.

didOverflowHeight.description: Whether the text overflowed its height.

ComposeSemanticsTokens.description: Resolved container design tokens for a node (#1897, extended in v4 #1908): from Modifier.background / Surface / Card, Modifier.border, the background/clip/border/graphicsLayer shape, Modifier.padding, and the Row/Column arrangement spacing.

backgroundColor.description: Resolved container/fill colour as ARGB hex `#AARRGGBB`.

borderColor.description: Resolved outline/stroke colour as ARGB hex `#AARRGGBB` from Modifier.border (#1908).

cornerRadius.description: Resolved corner radius in dp (`12.0dp`); non-uniform shapes emit four comma-separated corners. Percent/CircleShape corners resolve against the node's size and density (#1908).

shape.description: Shape-family descriptor for non-dp shapes (#1908): `circle` for CircleShape / all-CornerSize(50%), `cut` for CutCornerShape.

gap.description: Resolved Row/Column arrangement spacing in dp (`8.0dp`) from Arrangement.spacedBy (#1908).

ComposeSemanticsInsets.description: Per-edge padding in dp (`16.0dp`), resolved from Modifier.padding.
